artists.name: Orenvalt Archive
artists.summary: Night watches, lantern-lit walls and long marches: soundtracks from the borderlands of Orenvalt.

artists.name: Skralvoss
artists.summary: War music named for the shadow of conquest: drums, brass and battle choirs.

artists.name: Corenveld Music Hall
artists.summary: Fantasy orchestral music with baroque drive: riders, fairs, rain and shadow on the roads out of the capital of Orenvalt.

artists.name: Vrendskarr Echo
artists.summary: Neoclassical metal from the fjord where the echo arrives before the voice: solo violin against lead guitar.
